_doc: P(L0) = prior probability a child of this age has ALREADY attained the milestone, used to seed BKT. Hand this table to Dev 3. Fixed params apply to every skill.
source: Navchetana: National Framework for Early Childhood Stimulation 2024, Section 5.1 Early Developmental Milestones (pp. 61-62)

priors.milestone: begins to recognize the mother's face
develops a social smile
makes eye contact
raises head at times when on tummy
moves both arms and both legs when excited
keeps hands open and relaxed
keeps head steady when held upright and sits with support
turns head toward the direction of sound
attempts to reach and grasp an object
laughs aloud or makes squealing sounds
begins to babble sounds like 'ah, ee, oo' other than when crying
likes to look at oneself in a mirror
rolls over in both directions
grasps a toy by using all fingers
turns head to follow familiar faces or toys visually
looks for toys that have been hidden in front of them
responds to their name being called
sits without support and reaches for toys without falling
raises arms to be picked up
crawls to get desired toys without bumping into any objects
uses one or two common words in the mother tongue
responds to simple requests like 'no' or 'come here'
stands and takes several independent steps
uses a variety of familiar gestures like waving and clapping
puts pebbles or small objects in a container
names and identifies common objects and their pictures in a book
walks steadily even while pulling a toy
imitates household chores
correctly points out and names one or more body parts in person or in books
drinks from a cup without spilling
names most familiar things consistently
identifies colours and shapes
makes a sentence by joining three or more words
climbs up and down the stairs
